title: Barcelona from another perspective
text: We really liked the experience. As soon as we got on the boat they offered us a welcome drink and we started the tour along the coast of Barcelona. The truth is that seeing the city from the sea has its charm. We spent a very pleasant time, without rushing and enjoying the views. We would do it again without a doubt.
author: O1331KYbrunos
